| # Object 0x1301 to 0x1310 SRDO communication parameter {#object-0x1301-to-0x1310-srdo-communication-parameter-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the communication parameters for the SRDO\'s the device is able to receive or transmit.

 

  Index         0x1301 to 0x1310
  ------------- -----------------------------------
  Name          SRDO Communication Parameter
  Object Code   RECORD
  Data Type     SRDO parameter
  Category      Mandatory for each supported SRDO

 

 

SubIndex Supported

 

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- -----------------------------
  Description     Highest sub index supported
  Default value   0x06

 

  SubIndex        1
  --------------- -----------------------
  Description     Information direction
  Default value   0x00

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| SubIndex                          | 2                                 |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | Tx: Refresh time                  |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Rx:SCT                            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Default value                     | 0x03E8                            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| SubIndex                          | 3                                 |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | Tx: Not used                      |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Rx: SVT                           |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Default value                     | 0x0A                              |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

  SubIndex        4
  --------------- -------------------
  Description     Transmission type
  Default value   0xFE

 

  SubIndex        5
  --------------- ----------
  Description     COB-ID 1
  Default value   0x101

 

  SubIndex        6
  --------------- ----------
  Description     COB-ID 2
  Default value   0x102

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   By default all 64 SRDO\'s are not initialized. i.e Subindex 1 Information direction is 0. ASW is responsible for setting right direction after valid mapping is configured for each SRDO.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
